Caching the annotations

dot-annotated-services reads class annotations using doctrine/annotations and caches them using doctrine/cache.

Configuration

In order to cache annotations, you should register a service factory at key AbstractAnnotatedFactory::CACHE_SERVICE that should return a valid Doctrine\Common\Cache\Cache cache driver. See Cache Drivers for available implementations offered by doctrine.

See below an example on how you can configure dot-annotated-services to cache annotations. You can add this configuration values to your application's Doctrine config file:

    'annotations_cache_dir' => __DIR__ . '/../../data/cache/annotations',
    'dependencies' => [
        'factories' => [
            Dot\AnnotatedServices\Factory\AbstractAnnotatedFactory::CACHE_SERVICE => YourApp\Factory\AnnotationsCacheFactory::class,
        ],
    ];

where AnnotationsCacheFactory is a custom factory that needs to return a Doctrine Cache Driver:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace YourApp\Factory;

class AnnotationsCacheFactory
{
    public function __invoke(Psr\Container\ContainerInterface $container)
    {
        return new Doctrine\Common\Cache\FilesystemCache($container->get('config')['annotations_cache_dir']);
    }
}
